sources.snippet: An offline, lightweight Sequence-to-Sequence (Seq2Seq) Neural Machine Translation (NMT) system built from scratch in PyTorch. It translates Romanized Nepali text (including common chat slang) into native Devanagari script using a custom 2-layer Encoder-Decoder Transformer and SentencePiece subword tokenization.
